newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND CONSTITUTIONAL REFERENDUM SET FOR MAY 25.
newsitem.headline: POLAND CONSTITUTIONAL REFERENDUM SET FOR MAY 25.

text.p: Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski said on Wednesday he would set a nationwide constitutional referendum for May 25.

"I am going to announce the date of the constitutional referendum for May 25," Kwasniewski told parliament shortly after its its two houses houses passed a new constitution at a joint session to replace a communist-era charter.
The National Assembly overwhelmingly voted in favour of the new constitution, which guarantees civil and economic rights and keeps the separation of the state and the powerful Roman Catholic church.
The constitution will need a 50 percent plus one vote majority in referendum to become effective.
